milkeyway wrote: Hi. Any expert please review if my understanding is correct.

It's great to draw out how you think the market works, doing this is a great way to learn. However, it's never quite as simple as seeing price in isolation of the big picture. At a minimum, to read price correctly, one must look back into the price history and to look at the higher times to place any move into the context of the larger picture.

Now, lets change the bigger picture and add some price history.

Hope that helps. madwt

Hi MW,

You're noticing the correct areas I believe, what you're not doing is finding WHERE the actual DPs were made... I have made an example on your upper level, the SR flip, see what you think buddy.

Here is your initial 4hr level, don't worry that it does not look exactly the same as yours, I believe we have different server/broker times, that's all. On the 4hr chart we can see a clean break of resistance has been made, but where was the decision actually made, we find this by looking on the lower time frames.

Next up is the 15 min chart, notice we are getting closer to finding the DP, look at how this reacted, pip perfect nearly

Yes we could have taken a trade there, but why not look lower down to find a trade with lower risk, and far greater reward... Here is the 5 min TF

What a beauty this zone was, and look at the risk, literally only a few pips! I wanna get a closer look, so let's look at the minute chart

Can you see what happened? Something like this was most definitely not visible on the 5 min TF, let alone the 4hr TF. Can you see this was a beautiful FTR as price failed to return to the small SR flip below (not marked up but should be easy enough to see) and then engulfed the high, and also the HTF level, and BAM straight down to collect more buyers to satisfy the ITs need for LQ for the push up..
